tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (Linen). The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus, the logo panel.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards and inputs. Borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text (Charcoal), on surface and surface-raised. Also dark tiles in light mode.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Paragraph text, a touch softer than ink, on either surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, labels, metadata, on either surface (passes 4.5:1).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Brand green for shapes, the logo circle and illustrations. Not for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: sage-deep
tokens.usage: Primary colour: buttons, links, active states. As text, on surface or surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-sage-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sage-deep fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: tags, chips, highlighted rows.

tokens.name: sage-text
tokens.usage: Text on sage-soft (tag labels).

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Accent only: the logo colon and dot, small highlights, one series in charts. Too light for body text.

tokens.name: clay-text
tokens.usage: Clay as readable text (a warm link or note) on either surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of sage-deep.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px outline with a 2px offset.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tiny gaps: icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside tags and small groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked items in a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing and page margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels and hero blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags and chips.
